story.title: The Hour Glass
story.logline: A woman discovers her ticking clock necklace is actually counting down everyone else's remaining moments.
story.theme: The burden of knowing human expiration.
story.twist: The necklace doesn't count down time; it stops whenever she tells a lie.
story.ending: How many lives did your last truth just buy?

scenes.narration: My mother swore this brass pendant would measure my lifespan. But she lied to me.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elena, 25, dark messy hair, wearing a worn denim jacket, staring at a ticking glass pendant in a dim kitchen.

scenes.narration: Today the numbers froze at zero. Not mine. The old man across the street stopped moving entirely.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Elena, 25, dark messy hair, denim jacket, looking out a dusty window at a frozen street.

scenes.narration: I ran outside and screamed his name. The moment I confessed my terror, the numbers jumped back up.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Elena, 25, dark messy hair, denim jacket, shaking on a gray pavement holding the glowing pendant.

scenes.narration: That is when the terrible truth clawed its way into my throat. This glass does not track time.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elena, 25, dark messy hair, denim jacket, eyes wide with horror as numbers reflect in her pupils.

scenes.narration: It measures how much borrowed breath remains in the world before my next dishonesty steals it.
scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of Elena, 25, dark messy hair, denim jacket, standing alone in an empty city plaza.

scenes.narration: Every small white lie I tell buys a stranger another hour. Total honesty brings instant death.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of Elena, 25, dark messy hair, denim jacket, whispering nervously to a blank wall.

scenes.narration: I told my best friend she looked amazing yesterday. Instantly, a dying child in the hospital woke up.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Elena, 25, dark messy hair, denim jacket, gripping her phone inside a brightly lit cafe.

scenes.narration: So I started lying constantly. To everyone. About everything. Just to keep the fragile world breathing.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elena, 25, dark messy hair, denim jacket, smiling falsely while tears stream down her cheeks.

scenes.narration: My entire existence is now a manufactured fiction keeping strangers alive. I am a machine of deceit.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Elena, 25, dark messy hair, denim jacket, surrounded by floating digital numbers in a dark room.

scenes.narration: The pendant glows bright gold in my trembling hand. How many lives did your last truth just buy?
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of Elena, 25, dark messy hair, denim jacket, looking directly into the camera lens with a haunting gaze.

caption.hook: Every tick stole someone else's tomorrow.
caption.title: The Hour Glass
caption.caption: She thought her necklace measured life, but every second belonged to a stranger's fading breath. Until she finally told a lie, and the ticking stopped.
